ORDER 
On March 31, 2014, Entergy Arkansas, Inc. (M) filed a motion with the 
Arkansas Public Senice Commission (Commission) seeking approval of its revised 
estimate of costs for decommissioning Arkansas Nuclear One Units 1 and 2 (Motion). In 
Order No. 58 the Commission set a procedural schedule for proceedings on M'S 
Motion, Pursuant to the procedural schedule, the General Staff of the Commission 
(Staff) filed the Direct Testimony of Kim 0. 
Davis and EAI filed the Rebuttal Testimony 
of William A. Cloutier, Jr. Subsequently, the Commission entered Order No, 59 
granting the joint motion of EAI and Staff to waive the remainder of the procedural 
schedule and cancel the hearing in this matter. The matter is currently pending a 
decision by the Cornmission on the written record compiled by the parties. 
In Order No. 27 filed in this Docket on October 30, 1998, the Commission 
required that EAI file data regarding its nuclear decommissioning funds by November 1 a 
of each year. Because the information to be filed pursuant to Order No, 27 depends in 
part upon the resolution of EAI's pending Motion for approval of its decommissioning
